thread:
Meera Patel: Quick status check — ACME staging egress tests are flaky: some requests from their VPC hit 502s through our proxy, others succeed. Can network/runtime owners triage? cc @Alex Kim @Samir Gupta
Alex Kim: I saw something similar last week, could be SNI mismatch between proxy and upstream. @Leo Chen any cert rotations recently?
Samir Gupta: Not that I know of. I can run traceroutes and curl. Meera, can you paste a failing request id? Also are they on an air-gapped stack or using our shared egress?
Meera Patel: They’re on private (VPC) using our egress gateway (not air-gapped). Failing req ids: req-ACM-4021, req-ACM-4025. tcpdump snippet: ```17:24:01.123 IP 10.0.3.7.443 > 52.12.34.56.52000: Flags [S], seq 0``` — looks like handshake half-open.
Leo Chen: We did a small proxy cert rotation yesterday for "*.redwood-inference.net" — SNI could be the culprit if ACME is still targeting old hostname. I’ll pull TLS logs.
Samir Gupta: Running quick curl from staging: ```curl -v https://api.external-service.com -H 'Host: ext.example'``` getting `SSL: no alternative certificate`. If SNI mismatch, upstream may drop or send RST.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary egress-proxy v1.4.8 -> staging completed @2101234562
Alex Kim: If proxy rotated, we should fallback to legacy cert during rollout. Who has permission to roll that back on staging?
Leo Chen: @Alex I can roll back the cert on staging but need a 10m maintenance window. Samir, can you validate post-rollback and attach logs?
Samir Gupta: On it. Also adding firewall/NAT check — asymmetric NAT sometimes breaks TLS handshakes. @Meera can you confirm if ACME's NAT gateway is using SNAT or port preservation toggles?
Meera Patel: Confirmed: ACME uses a managed NAT gateway with ephemeral ports; no config changes on their side. They saw the issue across 3 regions.
Alex Kim: Plan: 1) Leo rollback cert on staging 2) Samir run curl + tcpdump 3) Meera/ACME run e2e. If green, schedule controlled cert-rollover with SNI backward-compat. Owners: proxy=Leo, runtime=Samir, customer contact=Meera. ETA ~30m. :thumbsup:
Meera Patel: :thumbsup: pinging ACME to stand by.
